title: No organiser-upgrade pipeline for events; any authenticated user can create/manage events
file_paths: backend/internal/top5events/service.go:105; backend/internal/onboarding (no events module); onb_merchant_type seed rows
expected: Customer must apply for organiser, get admin approval, then gain event creation
actual: POST /api/finance/events as plain customer returns 201 DRAFT; no application/status anywhere; onb_merchant_type has no events row
root_cause: Events module never consumed the merchant-onboarding pipeline; 'organiser' is implicit capability = events.organiser_id

title: Organiser sets platform fee: fee_bps accepted from client on event create
expected: Platform fee should be admin-configured; organiser must not influence fee_bps
actual: Client body fee_bps persisted verbatim (only <=0 defaults to 1000); contract lists fee_bps as request field
root_cause: Contract documents fee_bps as a create field — removing it needs a contract decision (platform-owned)

title: Live checkout broken: purchaseTickets sent promo_code/quantity and unwrapped a single Ticket as PurchaseResult
expected: POST /purchase per contract takes {tier_id, promo} and returns ONE Ticket
actual: Sent {quantity, promo_code} — both dropped server-side — and read res.tickets.length on a Ticket (crash); promo silently never applied
root_cause: Field-name drift from contracts/openapi.yaml + multi-quantity UI backed by single-ticket endpoint

title: Ticket gift unreachable: client posts 'cashtag', server requires 'recipient'
case_ids: (primary impact on events-b transfer cases; found during 8.x code review)
actual: cashtag field -> binding required fail -> every gift 400

title: Event detail omitted tiers; mobile detail screen crashes on e.tiers.filter
expected: EventDetail contract client expects tiers[] on GET /events/:id
actual: Response had no tiers field; live detail screen would TypeError on .filter
root_cause: Event model never carried tier list; mobile assumed it

title: CreateEvent had no field validation (empty title, end<start, past start all accepted until DB/generic 400)
expected: Field-specific 400s; past-start refused; publish of ended event refused
actual: Invalid input reached INSERT and surfaced opaque 'invalid request'
root_cause: Validation relied on DB CHECKs; no past-date rule existed anywhere

title: No aggregate venue capacity — tier capacities can over-allocate any intended venue total
file_paths: service.go AddTier; events table has no capacity column
expected: Sum of tier allocations capped at venue capacity server-side
actual: No ceiling exists; capacity is per-tier only
root_cause: Schema gap: events.capacity column never created

title: No organiser profile/compliance entity (public page, slug, payout account, business contact, terms)
expected: Organiser profile with branding, payout, legal fields
root_cause: Module scoped organiser to 'owner of event' only

title: No venue/seat-map/geolocation model (assigned seating, accessible seats, seat labels, venue tz/geo, map links)
file_paths: no seat/venue tables; venue is free-text
expected: Seat maps, holds with TTL, geo+tz per venue
actual: Feature absent; GA capacity analog only
root_cause: Out of scope of shipped module

title: No optimistic-concurrency control on organiser event edits (last write wins); no admin dual-control on sensitive actions
expected: Version/If-Match or conflict detection on PATCH; reauth/dual-control for irreversible admin actions
actual: No version field on events; PATCH overwrites under row lock only

title: No virtual/hybrid/unlisted/private event model; no image set or rich-text sanitisation
expected: Event format + visibility enum + content limits
root_cause: Out of scope of shipped module
